newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Yilmaz to discuss bid to form government.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Yilmaz to discuss bid to form government.

text.p: Turkish conservative leader Mesut Yilmaz has called a news conference for Wednesday on his bid to form a government that would exclude Islamists, party officials said.
They said the Motherland Party leader would hold the news conference at 1200 (0900 GMT) in parliament.
President Suleyman Demirel has appointed Yilmaz as prime minister-designate to replace Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan, who resigned last week under army pressure.
Yilmaz has given himself until early next week to present Demirel with a cabinet list.
He has won the backing of secularist MPs on both the left and right but is still short of the simple majority needed to win a parliamentary vote of confidence in the 550-member parliament.
